summary: Starts for the admin address from many IPs could use up the day's sign-in emails, so the admin's own sign-in on a new day sent nothing until midnight UTC.
fix: A per-address limit on sign-in emails (3 an hour, keyed by a hash, counted after the answer so its timing is the same for every address), and 2 of the 8 daily sign-in emails are kept for the browser the admin last signed in on (a signed cookie set when a sign-in succeeds); that browser also skips the per-address limit.
